subject: Intro call + compliance discovery — SOC 2, PT access, vuln process
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearhealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Compliance items from today's call

Hi Sofia / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope procurement/security review: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm current attestation status (Type I/II and most recent date)?
- GDPR / HIPAA: we need a short statement about how you treat ePHI and controller/processor responsibilities.
- Pen test: are you able to share a recent penetration test report (redacted) and an outline of your vuln disclosure process?
- Scanning cadence & SLAs: what is your cadence for authenticated scans, and typical triage/remediation SLAs (critical/ high/ medium)?

I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx) — we'll fill the business sections but will need some of your security/infosec team to answer the technical questions.

Next steps we'd prefer:
1) Receipt of a redacted PT report (or access path) + SOC 2 summary by end of next week
2) Proposed contact on your security team for the questionnaire (we can share specific Qs now)
3) If necessary, execute an NDA to get the unredacted PT result later in the cycle

Can Ben or someone from your side confirm an owner and an ETA? Happy to jump on a 30 minute call if that helps.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Turner
Senior PM, Vendor Risk
ClearHealth

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance items from today's call

Hi Olivia —

Great to meet you earlier — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation for our control environment; the most recent assessment was completed in Mar 2027. We can share a SOC 2 summary and the auditor letter right away (redacted version) — link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/soc2-summary

GDPR / HIPAA: We process customer data as a processor by default. For HIPAA customers, we offer a Business Associate Addendum (BAA) and maintain administrative/technical safeguards consistent with covered entity expectations. I'll have Ben and Marissa drop a short statement for the questionnaire sections.

Pen test access & vuln process: high level —
- Pen test cadence: annual third-party penetration test + quarterly external authenticated scans and monthly internal vulnerability scanning.
- Report access: we can provide a redacted pen test report (PII and customer-specific details removed) immediately. For the full report we require an NDA and a brief intake call with our security team to confirm scope and sharing terms.
- Vulnerability SLAs (typical): Critical: acknowledgment within 48 hours, mitigation plan within 7 business days and remediation target 30 days (or immediate workaround if customer facing). High: acknowledgment within 72 hours, 30-60 day remediation depending on mitigations. Medium/Low: standard backlog/patch cycle.

Attachments I can share now: redwood-security-brief.pdf (controls summary) and a redacted pen test summary. If that looks good, can you sign the mutual NDA (or we can use your standard NDA) and we'll route the more detailed artifact.

Proposed owner on our side: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai) — she handles pen test coordination and can answer the questionnaire specifics. Ben will own commercial intake and timeline.

Next step options:
- We upload redacted PT + SOC summary to the drive link above by Fri 2027-04-23
- Marissa to review the vendor questionnaire and mark which Qs require security input — target ETA Wed 2027-04-28
- If you agree, we'll generate a mutual NDA (DocuSign) to enable full report access — we can send that today.

If you'd like to lock a short call with Marissa, propose times and we'll confirm.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance items from today's call

Hi Olivia —

Looping in with the specifics you asked for. I'm the security lead who coordinates external assessments and report sharing. A few clarifications and what we can deliver immediately: 

1) Pen test report: we have a third-party assessment from Nov 2026. We can provide a redacted PDF (no customer data, no exploit PoC). Ive attached the redacted report to this thread (redwood-pen-test-2026-redacted.pdf). For the unredacted version, our policy is to require a mutual NDA + a short intake call with the receiving team to confirm handling and storage expectations.

2) Vulnerability management process:
- Scanning cadence: monthly internal scans, weekly external/hosted scans for public endpoints, quarterly full authenticated scans.
- Triage: automated tickets created in our Jira instance and routed to owners. Critical vulns are escalated to an on-call engineer and product/security leadership.
- SLA examples: Critical ack within 48h; mitigation plan w/in 7 business days; patch/mitigation target 30 days (exceptions documented case-by-case).

3) Disclosure & coordination: We follow a coordinated disclosure policy. We notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming exploitability and provide recommended mitigations, planned timelines, and status updates. Public disclosure only after remediation or a risk-accepted decision by leadership.

4) Questionnaire: Sofia / Ben, happy to take the technical Qs in the attached spreadsheet. Olivia, if you can flag which questions are gating for procurement well prioritize those first.

I'll send a mutual NDA template via DocuSign if you confirm you'd like the unredacted material.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Applied Security | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-2026-redacted.pdf
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@clearhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance items from today's call

Thanks Sofia / Marissa — this is perfect and moves things along fast.

I downloaded the redacted PT and the SOC summary. A couple quick asks:
- Can you add the exact audit firm name / contact (for SOC 2) in the SOC summary we received? We only need the auditor contact to validate dates and scope.
- We'll mark the vendor questionnaire with 6 gating Qs — I'll share back by EOD Monday.
- Please send the DocuSign NDA and let's aim to get the intake call scheduled the week of 4/26 so our security team can review the full PT.

Ben — can you coord on the NDA + intake call times? Open times here: Mon 4/26 10-12PT, Tue 4/27 14-16PT.

Olivia
Olivia Turner
Senior PM, Vendor Risk | ClearHealth
